tests.name: Route-maps and prefix-lists with customer names
tests.input:
Show all customer route-maps and prefix-lists on NYC-PE-01.

--- NYC-PE-01 ---
hostname NYC-PE-01
!
ip prefix-list PL-CUST-ACME-IN seq 10 permit 172.20.0.0/16 le 24
ip prefix-list PL-CUST-ACME-IN seq 20 permit 172.21.0.0/16 le 24
ip prefix-list PL-CUST-ACME-IN seq 30 permit 192.168.50.0/24
!
ip prefix-list PL-CUST-GLOBEX-IN seq 10 permit 10.50.0.0/16 le 24
ip prefix-list PL-CUST-GLOBEX-IN seq 20 permit 10.51.0.0/16 le 24
!
ip prefix-list PL-CUST-INITECH-IN seq 10 permit 172.30.0.0/16 le 24
!
route-map RM-CUST-ACME-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-CUST-ACME-IN
 set local-preference 200
 set community 65000:100 additive
route-map RM-CUST-ACME-IN deny 20
!
route-map RM-CUST-ACME-OUT permit 10
 match community COMM-CUST-ACME
!
route-map RM-CUST-GLOBEX-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-CUST-GLOBEX-IN
 set local-preference 200
 set community 65000:200 additive
route-map RM-CUST-GLOBEX-IN deny 20
!
route-map RM-CUST-INITECH-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-CUST-INITECH-IN
 set local-preference 150
 set community 65000:300 additive
route-map RM-CUST-INITECH-IN deny 20
!
ip community-list standard COMM-CUST-ACME permit 65000:100
ip community-list standard COMM-CUST-GLOBEX permit 65000:200
ip community-list standard COMM-CUST-INITECH permit 65000:300

tests.name: QoS policy maps with customer-specific shaping
tests.input:
Show QoS configs applied to customer interfaces on NYC-PE-01.

--- NYC-PE-01 ---
hostname NYC-PE-01
!
class-map match-any CM-CUST-VOICE
 match dscp ef
 match dscp cs5
class-map match-any CM-CUST-VIDEO
 match dscp af41
 match dscp cs4
class-map match-any CM-CUST-CRITICAL
 match dscp af31
 match dscp cs3
!
policy-map PM-CUST-100M
 class CM-CUST-VOICE
  priority 10000
 class CM-CUST-VIDEO
  bandwidth 20000
 class CM-CUST-CRITICAL
  bandwidth 30000
 class class-default
  fair-queue
!
policy-map PM-CUST-ACME-SHAPE
 class class-default
  shape average 100000000
  service-policy PM-CUST-100M
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1.100
 description CID:ACME-NYC-001 CUST:Acme_Corp
 ip vrf forwarding VRF-ACME
 ip address 10.100.0.1 255.255.255.252
 service-policy output PM-CUST-ACME-SHAPE
!
policy-map PM-CUST-1G
 class CM-CUST-VOICE
  priority 100000
 class CM-CUST-VIDEO
  bandwidth 200000
 class CM-CUST-CRITICAL
  bandwidth 300000
 class class-default
  fair-queue
!
policy-map PM-CUST-GLOBEX-SHAPE
 class class-default
  shape average 1000000000
  service-policy PM-CUST-1G
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1.200
 description CID:GLOB-NYC-042 CUST:Globex_International
 ip vrf forwarding VRF-GLOBEX
 ip address 10.100.1.1 255.255.255.252
 service-policy output PM-CUST-GLOBEX-SHAPE
